name: (Spring-Heeled Jack) Change Shape

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: Spring-Heeled Jack takes on the appearance of a Medium humanoid dressed in exquisite finery. This doesn't change his Speed or his attack and damage modifiers with his Strikes. When in this form, Spring-Heeled Jack gains a Diplomacy modifier equal to his Intimidation modifier.
